subject: Req 77 — Hiring committee decision and closeout (no hire)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Hiring Committee <hiring-committee@redwood.com>; Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Req 77 candidate review + recommendation (scorecards attached)

Hi team,

Following the interview loop for Req 77 (Platform — Senior Infra), I've collected the panel scorecards and a short calibration summary. Documents attached: req77-scorecards.pdf, candidate-ethan-liu-resume.pdf.

Quick summary:
- Candidate: Ethan Liu (external)
- Strengths: solid systems design, good culture fit, strong collaboration examples.
- Concerns: depth of core infra experience below the bar for Senior Platform (multiple panelists flagged gaps in distributed state handling and low-level performance tuning).
- Compensation: candidate expects ~20% above the top of the posted band; total comp ask with stock would push this into the next band.

Recommendation: Close Req 77 as "no hire" at this time. Primary reasons: band misalignment (comp) and an experience gap that would require a stretch hire with higher risk. If the committee prefers, we can table and reopen with revised band or continue a list for L4 hires.

Ask: please reply with +1 to approve closeout or with alternative next steps. If we approve closeout, I'll notify the candidate with a warm rejection + feedback and update the headcount tracker.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: req77-scorecards.pdf (10 pages), candidate-ethan-liu-resume.pdf

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Hiring Committee <hiring-committee@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 11:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Req 77 candidate review + recommendation (scorecards attached)

Thanks Marissa — I reviewed the scorecards and the calibration notes. I support the recommendation to close Req 77 for the following reasons:

- Band/compensation: we can't stretch the posted band for a single hire without cascading compensation pressure across the org.
- Skill mismatch: several panels noted the candidate would need significant ramp on low-level infra skills that are mission-critical for the role.
- Headcount posture: current hiring discipline requires we prioritize roles with clearer runway to impact.

Please proceed with the closeout. Action items:
1) Marissa: send candidate closure email with constructive feedback and keep them in the "future backfills" bucket if they agree.
2) Recruiting: mark the req as closed in Greenhouse and update the headcount tracker (see link).
3) Hiring ops: capture the lesson on sourcing for the next req — we should source more hires with demonstrable low-level infra kernels work.

If anyone objects, flag now; otherwise this thread will be the formal record and I'll mark the req as closed on my side.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Director, Platform Engineering (Hiring Committee)
